system.description:
Type

Genjutsu/Ninjutsu

Nature

Neutral

Rank

E

Chakra Cost

1 Chakra per clone

Duration

Instantaneous

Action Cost

1 Action per clone

Action Type

Special

Range

Self

Description

A simple technique in which the user creates a number of massless shells of chakra equal to the amount of Chakra spent with a form perfectly identical to the user at a glance. These Clones appear by the user’s side and cannot stray more than [5 + FB] paces away from them.

The duplicates are perfect duplicates of the shinobi, but are incapable of speech nor can they perform any action that requires physical contact, like lifting an object or attacking a creature. Once touched by another creature or object or violently shaken, a clone disappears in a puff of smoke.

Enemies with a [PB] less than the User’s [WB] have -10 to all rolls made to identify the original from their duplicates based on the number of clones within sight to a maximum of 3. The action spent to summon these illusory duplicates also sets them to follow one of the following orders: Follow Me or Scatter. Changing the Order costs 1AP.
* Follow Me: The duplicates mimic the user’s actions in a natural seeming manner, sacrificing itself in order to reveal an opening for the user adding +10% to the user’s next Taijutsu or Bukijutsu attack.
* Every time an attack is made with the “Follow Me” order active, one of the clones made by the jutsu is destroyed.
* Scatter: The duplicates fan out in a confusing way, inflicting a -10% Base Chance Modifier to the next Awareness or Scrutinize roll an enemy makes to find the user.
system.criticalSuccess: Your first attack using the Follow Me order doesn't consume one of your clones.
system.criticalFailure: The jutsu fails, creating a series of confoundingly bad simulacra, you suffer the Stunned condition until the end of your next turn.
system.sublimeSuccess: As Critical Success, but your next attack under Follow Me order is made at Advantage.
system.sublimeFailure: As Critical Failure, but you also suffer the Surprised condition.

system.description:
Type

Genjutsu/Ninjutsu

Nature

Neutral

Rank

E

Chakra Cost

3 (Simple Illusion) or 10 (Complex Shell)

Duration

Maintained (1 Chakra per Hour; 3 Chakra per Round)

Action Cost

1

Action Type

Special

Range

Self

Description

The user assumes the form of a creature of the same size category as they are. They may freely designate the specifics of their new form (such as height, hair texture and color, skin tone, etc.). This form is, by default, purely illusory and as such can be dispelled by a strong jostling by an outside force such as being shoved into a wall or stepping on a lego. The illusion is purely visual and does not include any other sensory details.

Additionally, it is possible to use this technique to create a complex illusion allowing the user to assume the form of a creature or item of their size category or smaller taking on the shape, weight, and even mass of their new form, but having no ability to mimic any of their biological or mystical abilities.)
system.duration: Maintained (1 Chakra per Hour; 3 Chakra per Round)

1

Special

Range

Description

The user covers themselves with a cloak that has a color and pattern matching the nearby surroundings, concealing their presence by seamlessly blending in. The user can then gather intel from their position or wait for an opportunity to stage an ambush on unsuspecting targets.

Whilst unmoving, the user rolls with Advantage on their Stealth Check. Additionally, if they initiate a surprise attack, enemies have a -10% (Challenging) penalty to their Awareness rolls.

Type

Ninjutsu

Nature

Neutral

Rank

E

Chakra Cost

2

Duration

Instantaneous

Action Cost

1

Action Type

Reaction

Range

Self

Description

The instant before they are to be struck by a ranged attack, the user replaces themselves with a block of wood or object with a similar mass. Roll Dodge against the triggering attack at Advantage. On a success, you may move up to half your Movement in any direction without provoking an Attack of Opportunity.
system.criticalSuccess: You waive the AP cost of this technique.
system.criticalFailure: Your foe acts faster than you anticipated, you gain the Surprised condition.
system.sublimeSuccess: As Critical, but you may move up to your full Movement without provoking an Attack of Opportunity.

6

Duration

Instantaneous

2

Action Type

Attack

Range

Short (1-5 Paces) Cone

Description

You touch a surface directly connected to the target area and send a volatile wave of sound towards it, having an effect based on the type of surface in the targeted area.
* Hard Ground: The wave sends debris flying in all directions; dealing (2d6 + [WB]) damage. A single square inside the area is treated as though it has caltrops spread over it until it is repaired.
* Soft Ground: A wave of mud or a cloud of sand and/or dirt is sent flying up, inflicting [Blinded] on all creatures for (1d6 + [WB]) rounds unless they succeed at a Toughness check.

Description

With a flicker of hand seals, the shinobi flings a single palm-sized projectile at an enemy within range. This construct has all the traits of the weapon it's a facsimile of, but may add [WB] to the range instead of [PB].
system.criticalSuccess: You may instead make a pair of similar projectiles to attack one or more targets, ignoring the Multi-Attack Penalty.
system.sublimeSuccess: You instead create a brace of similar projectiles that attack all characters in a Cone, ignoring the Multi-Attack Penalty.

system.sublimeFailure: As Critical Failure, except you are also rendered defenseless and knocked Prone.

You form a spear of ice chakra and launch it at an enemy within range, dealing (1d6 + [WB]) damage.
system.criticalSuccess: You deal an additional 2d4 Affinity damage and force the enemy enemy to roll a Toughness-test. If they fail, they suffer a -10% Base Chance Penalty on all Agility-rolls until they pass the test (which can be re-attempted once per round for 1AP).

You twist your chakra into a thin nigh-imperceptible spike at up to ([FB]/2, rounded down) targets within range, forcing them to roll a Resolve-test. If they fail, you overwhelm their senses with a soul-deep chill, causing them to suffer (1d6 + [FB]) Peril damage.

Quickly packing and hurling Ice chakra into a fist-sized ball of snow around a dense core of ice, you roll to attack a single target with Ninjutsu, dealing 1d8 Affinity damage on a success.
system.criticalSuccess: You deal [WB] additional damage and force the enemy enemy to roll a Toughness-test. If they fail, they suffer a -10% Base Chance Penalty on all Agility-rolls until they pass the test (which can be re-attempted once per round for 1AP).
system.sublimeSuccess: As Critical Success, except you fire 2 attacks, ignoring the multi-attack penalty, that may target the same or multiple characters within range.

Nature

Rank

C

Chakra Cost

3/clone

Duration

Instantaneous

Action Cost

1/clone

Action Type

Special

Range

Self

Description

You call upon the roiling ephemeral smoke chakra within yourself and produce a semi-solid clone mimicking your form made of Smoke-Natured Chakra. The Clones have the statistics of a [Smoke Clone] and have no autonomy and thus each one must be controlled individually by the [Control Companion] Action. When the Smoke Clone is destroyed it pops and violently expels Harsh Smoke in a [Burst] Template forcing them to resist a Challenging (-10%) Toughness Test or become Disoriented until the end of their next turn.

Description

You create a thick veil of smoke around yourself and your allies, providing cover and aiding in stealth or escape. Providing Advantage on Stealth Rolls and attack rolls from Stealth as long as it is active.
